prompt:
You maintain a running summary of a long engineering document that is being read part by part, so that a later reader can model the system in SysML v2 without seeing the earlier parts.
Update the summary with the new part. Keep, as compactly as possible: the full names of system elements, actors and items; every alias or call sign with the full name it stands for; which element produces, sends or receives which item; modes and normative requirements. At most 300 words.

Current summary:
Offshore wind farm O&M concept. Scope: offshore generation assets, marine/shore support facilities, operational personnel, external organizations, control functions, and maintenance for safe generation in a variable marine environment where access, equipment condition and grid requirements affect timing of work. Physical boundary: turbine structures, turbine array, Offshore Substation (alias Morrowick; offshore electrical collection/switching). Electrical boundary: export connection up to the Grid Interface Relay (interface to external grid). Turbine elements: Turbine Controller (alias Glassfin; per-turbine control function), Pitch System, Rotor Brake Unit, Converter Cabinet, Nacelle Condition Monitor (the last two are distinct equipment for maintenance/condition review), Turbine Sensor Bus. Blade Inspection Drone performs blade assessment. Substation/export: Main Transformer, Export Cable Monitor. SCADA Gateway is the supervisory monitoring/control interface. Shore Control Room is a shore location for authorized personnel, providing continuous monitoring and dispatch coordination with Fleet Dispatch Console (resource coordination) and Maintenance Planning Engine (maintenance preparation/sequencing). Marine: Crew Transfer Vessel, Daughter Craft, Service Operations Vessel, Helideck, vessel procedures. Workforce access: North Access Scanner, South Access Scanner, Personnel Tracking Console. Supply: Warehouse System, Spares Hub (inventory/replenishment). External: Weather Service (alias Pale Lantern), Metocean Buoy (offshore environmental observations), grid dispatch/operations, ports, suppliers, emergency services. Enabling functions in boundary: cybersecurity, communications, fire protection, backup power. Out of scope: public grid beyond connection point; non-farm port operations. Objectives: reliable generation with personnel safety and asset integrity; availability via condition monitoring, timely fault response, planned maintenance, coordinated access. Requirements: work shall be authorized, hazards controlled, personnel and vessels accounted for; prevent pollution, minimize marine disturbance, respond promptly to environmental incidents. Modes: commissioning/acceptance (documented handover from construction to operations control), normal service (decisions on validated status, procedures, forecasts, grid instructions), planned maintenance (by condition, resources, access, production), unplanned maintenance (prioritized fault assessment, severity-based mobilization), major refurbishment, decommissioning (safe isolation, removal planning, transfer of residual records).

New part:
S045: Crew Transfer Vessel, Daughter Craft, and Service Operations Vessel represent marine resources that may support offshore work.
S046: Helideck is included as an access facility for activities supported by helicopter operations.
S047: Personnel Tracking Console represents the personnel location and accountability function.
S048: Warehouse System and Spares Hub represent the inventory and logistics context for maintenance materials.
S049: Work Permit Portal and Cybersecurity Gateway represent enabling functions that support controlled and secure operations.
S050: The operating concept also recognizes grid, emergency response, communications, and port support as external or enabling capabilities.
S051: The system architecture separates offshore equipment, operational services, and shore-based decision functions while preserving defined interfaces between them.
S052: The SCADA Gateway provides a controlled boundary for supervisory data exchange between offshore assets and shore-based operations.
S053: For this concept, SCADA Gateway is designated Juniper Vale as its operational alias.
S054: The Maintenance Planning Engine supports work preparation by organizing maintenance needs, resource considerations, and planning constraints.
S055: For this concept, Maintenance Planning Engine is designated Thistle Crown as its operational alias.
S056: The Shore Control Room is the principal shore-based setting for monitoring and coordinating wind farm operations.
S057: For this concept, Shore Control Room is designated Amber Quay as its operational alias.
S058: These three components have distinct responsibilities and are treated as cooperating parts of one operational system.
S059: The SCADA Gateway mediates supervisory exchanges and supports consistent access to operational information.
S060: The Turbine Controller performs local turbine control functions within the offshore equipment environment.
S061: The Turbine Controller produces the Pitch Deviation Notice for operational handling.
S062: The SCADA Engineer maintains the configuration and technical integrity of supervisory interfaces.
S063: The Control Engineer uses the shore-based operational picture to assess equipment status and coordinate response.
S064: The Shore Control Room provides a shared operational context for personnel responsible for offshore assets.
S065: The Duty Planner uses the Maintenance Planning Engine to prepare and review maintenance activities.
S066: The Maintenance Planning Engine supports planning decisions without replacing the judgment of the Duty Planner.
S067: The Weather Service contributes environmental information to operational planning and coordination.
S068: The Marine Coordinator considers offshore conditions and vessel availability when coordinating access to work sites.
S069: The Fleet Dispatch Console provides a fleet-level view of dispatch activity for operational coordination.
S070: The Work Permit Portal supports authorization processes that govern work under controlled conditions.

Return JSON {"summary": "..."}.
